scope: Hash-bound AC1032 physical HEADER page and decoded envelope accounting for an external source sample; no parser behavior was changed.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: The section map identifies the HEADER section and its physical page references.
The decoded AcDb:Header envelope contains a begin sentinel, size fields, CRC, and end sentinel; compare the validated trailer end to the decoded logical-section size when accounting for suffix bytes.

source.provenance: ACadSharp's recorded sample-generation script invokes AutoCAD SAVEAS for R2018 and history records these bytes; the host executable and execution log are not bound to this file hash. See p6-imagedef-cross-version-soft-role-evidence-2026-11-07.json.

decodedHeaderEnvelope.compatibilityDiagnostic: The reader reports HeaderSectionCompatibility expected=848, observed=852 while admitting the zero high-size-word profile. This receipt does not assert whether that producer-facing severity is correct.

implementationObservation.observation: The reader parsed the HEADER envelope with zero unclaimed bytes and matching traced CRC values. It published all 842 observed source frames with zero entity/object parse failures. Strict output later refused a standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA record with no qualified replay path.

limitations: The save script supports AutoCAD SAVEAS provenance but does not bind the host executable or run log to these bytes.
The AC1032 production reader remains the documented pass-through stub; this HEADER observation does not qualify R2018 page-map, compression, or general reader support.
This exact-envelope profile does not classify the separate LibreDWG Line.dwg suffix observed in p6-ac1032-libredwg-line-header-suffix-triage-2026-11-07.json.
CRC is computed by libdxfrw itself, not by an independent implementation; no output or support claim is promoted.
